findings.summary: PUBLIC -ffp-contract=off turns off FMA contraction in every target that links math on aarch64, not only the math code (carried over from the previous review; declared deviation, unchanged)
findings.scenario: On aarch64, engine, physics and game code that links math loses fused multiply-add, which can cost performance in hot loops outside math. The bit-exact Vector4 batch edge tests need it for the inline header code, and CI has no benchmark to measure the cost.
